adjudication.rationale: Diff adds nontrivial new behavior in `TopicEmbed.import_remote` (uses `ruby-readability`, whitelist `tags`/`attributes`, and `opts[:title] || doc.title` fallback) and makes it a dependency of `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` (`TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, @embed_url)`) and the rewritten `disqus:import` task (`TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`). However, the new `spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb` only exercises `.import` and does not call `.import_remote` at all. Also, `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` is never exercised against real DB data; in `embed_controller_spec.rb` it is only mocked (`expects(:topic_id_for_embed).returns(...)`). This is a concrete test coverage gap for newly introduced/rewired logic, increasing regression risk while leaving the suite green.
